description.p: With WhatsApp on the desktop, you can seamlessly sync all of your chats to your computer so that you can chat on whatever device is most convenient to you.
NOTE: This wrapper is not verified by, affiliated with, or supported by WhatsApp Inc.
Pure Native Interface with Silent Performance Optimizations:

ul.li: Completely removed custom in-app drawer, options menu, and custom dock button for a 100% native, untouched WhatsApp Web interface

Retained zero-configuration silent background optimizations: WebRTC Privacy Shield (IP leak prevention), visual word-by-word Ctrl+Arrow navigation in message composer, and direct document download controller
Seamless system dark/light theme integration via nativeTheme.themeSource

description.p: Exact WhatsApp Modern Dark Mode Theme Color Match:

ul.li: Updated drawer background and header to exact WhatsApp Web dark theme charcoal (#161717)
Updated cards, borders, and controls to match WhatsApp native dark palette (#202222 card background, #2e2f2f border)
Refined text contrast (#fafafa title, #9da0a2 subtitle) matching WhatsApp native settings drawer

description.p: Dynamic System and WhatsApp Dark Mode Theme Integration:

ul.li: Integrated Electron nativeTheme.themeSource = 'system' to seamlessly synchronize OS dark/light mode
Redesigned Covenant Settings Drawer styles to automatically match WhatsApp dark mode palette (#111b21 background, #202c33 cards, #e9edef text)
Real-time theme watcher synchronizing drawer colors whenever WhatsApp or the system theme changes
Fixed white drawer box and invisible text in dark mode

description.p: ZapZap Enhancements Integration & Clean Native Experience Release:

ul.li: Adopted ZapZap features: WebRTC IP Privacy Shield, Ctrl+Arrow word navigation fix in message composer, and direct document click controller
Removed custom theme overrides to let WhatsApp Web render 100% natively in official Dark or Light mode
Removed external GitHub button from Covenant settings options
Clean native drawer interface integrated directly above WhatsApp Settings button with transparent Covenant gear icon
Applied theme colors to 100% of the WhatsApp interface: Left Navigation Rail (Dock), Main Conversation Header, Sidebar Header, Search & Filter Pills, Message Bubbles, Cards, and Footer Composer
Preserved official WhatsApp doodle wallpaper in full clarity behind all messages
Unified all panels, dropdowns, and borders to eliminate any remaining white container artifacts

description.p: WhatsApp Doodle Wallpaper Preservation and Theme Unification Release:

ul.li: Preserved the official WhatsApp doodle background drawings across all themes (OLED, Dracula, Catppuccin, Nord)
Completely removed sidebar resizing to let WhatsApp manage its contact list natively with zero layout deformation
Unified theme colors and dark class syncing to eliminate any zebra striping or white container artifacts
Enhanced in-app Covenant drawer with transparent gear dock icon and instant real-time theme preview

description.p: Covenant In-App Experience and Layout Polish Release:

ul.li: Integrated native-style WhatsApp settings drawer embedded directly in the chat sidebar matching light/dark theme seamlessly
Transparent background for the exclusive Covenant gear with lightning icon
Draggable vertical splitter line between chats and conversation with zero contacts list deformation
Instant live theme switching, anti-spy privacy, and isolated second account support
Optimized build pipeline using system RAM for ultra-fast packaging
Fixed preload startup crash caused by early MutationObserver execution
Properly located WhatsApp left dock navigation bar and injected Covenant gear button directly above WhatsApp Settings
In-page modal settings dialog with live theme application and anti-spy privacy options
Preserved 100% native layout fidelity with zero chat list deformation
Clean system tray menu
Fixed layout deformation: reset any forced sidebar widths to guarantee 100% native layout fidelity
Injected Covenant button directly into the dock above the native settings gear
Removed all options from the tray menu for a minimal and clean tray
In-page modal options with zero external windows
Fixed preload script module resolution by making preload 100% self-contained
Ensured dock gear button and floating fallback are visible under all circumstances
Fixed tray menu actions and keyboard shortcuts
Sidebar resizing is now completely natural and automatic: simply hover and drag the chat list border without needing to toggle any options
In-page Covenant Settings Modal: opens seamlessly directly inside WhatsApp Web without opening external windows (Ctrl+,)
Covenant Gear icon placed at the bottom of the left navigation rail, right above WhatsApp's native settings
Themes now apply automatically in real time across the entire interface (OLED, Dracula, Catppuccin, Nord)

description.p: Exclusive Covenant Features (disabled by default, configurable in Settings):

ul.li: Interactive Draggable Sidebar Divider: freely resize the chat list column width
Covenant Anti-Spy Privacy Suite: blur profile photos, names, message previews with hover-to-reveal, and auto-blur on window focus loss (Ctrl+Shift+P)
Exclusive Premium Dark Themes: OLED True Black (#000000), Dracula, Catppuccin Mocha, and Nord
Isolated Multi-Account Session: run a second simultaneous WhatsApp account (Personal/Work) without conflicts
Exclusive Covenant Settings Panel featuring the official Covenant brand, quick shortcuts, and tray quick-access
Always on Top window toggle shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+M)
Fixed tray icon becoming invisible on dark themes when unread messages arrive
Added multi-resolution tray and app icons (16px to 512px)
Resilient tray icon fallbacks and resource path lookups
Updated to Electron 33+ with modern Chromium engine
Dynamic user-agent handling to resolve WhatsApp Web browser version incompatibility
Microphone and webcam permissions for voice notes and video calls
Native Wayland support with automatic X11 fallback
Improved system tray click actions and resilient icon resolution
Multi-monitor safe window position and bounds restoration
Linux packaging targets: AppImage, DEB, Pacman
Closing the window now doesn't quit the app
Update browser message after suspend
Wrong "minimize to tray" label in tray menu on some DEs
Missing app icon on KDE
Duplicated icon in taskbar on KDE
Bug fixes
New unread chats item in the tray menu
The window close button now quits the app (click the "minimize to tray" tray menu item to hide the window)
New tray icon with higher resolution
Use the "--start-hidden" argument to start WhatsApp in tray
WhatsApp can now minimize to tray
Scaling the window is now possible with Ctrl+"+", Ctrl+0 and Ctrl+"-"
Bug fixes
Clicking a notification now focuses the window
Quit WhatsApp with Ctrl+Q and Ctrl+W
Bug fixes
